source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe ECRC TX/RX Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Uses fixed 0:0:1/core3/port0 with errortype 2 TX and 3 RX and states that each injection immediately resets the system before post-boot dmesg review.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls these correctable errors, expects tool PASS and OS report within undefined timeout, conflicting with mandatory immediate resets.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; a broad live dmesg grep cannot survive/reset-correlate either stimulus and conflates ECRC with LCRC, poison and fatal.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; preserves two reset cycles and safety gates but assumes TX/RX flag meanings and treats post-boot dmesg as sufficient without durable source/severity proof.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC Plug a NIC (Network Interface Card) device on a target PCIe slot on the SUT / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotinfo 6. PCIe ECRC TX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 2 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 6.1 The system will reset immediately. 6.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 7. PCIe ECRC RX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 3 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 7.1 The system will reset immediately. 7.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- PCIe slot 1~N: inject the PCIe ECRC on PCIe slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'pcier|aer|ecrc|lcrc|poisoned|fatal'; echo __PCIe_ECRC_on_PCIe_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

disposition_reason: Immediate reset destroys volatile context, so evidence must be captured by firmware/BMC or OOB console before relying on post-boot logs. test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify ECRC transmit and receive fault handling for every required PCIe slot, including the specified immediate reset for each direction, attributable durable error evidence, successful reboot and restored NIC/link health.
required_package: Vendor proof for pcieerror errortype 2/3 TX/RX semantics and relation to errortype 2 in einjbiopcie
Decision whether each ECRC is correctable, fatal, or intentionally reset-producing and why
Physical slot/NIC/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for all targets
Decoded 7EF6030, masks, DPC, Reset After Sync-Flood and SyncFlood policy
Durable AER/BMC/UEFI source/severity evidence and reset/firmware/boot/link recovery deadlines
Supported OS, traffic isolation, aborts, OOB recovery and exact restoration
test_case.test_command: Reconcile correctable Criteria with mandatory reset and prove pcieerror errortype 2/3 direction semantics; map every physical slot/NIC to NBIO/core/port; decode severity/DPC/SyncFlood policy; establish isolated traffic and durable OOB capture; inject TX once, recover and archive evidence fully, then independently inject RX; timestamp reset/firmware/boot, correlate ECRC source and direction, verify NIC/link/traffic health and restore all state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.

safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and known-good boot/reimage path
Quiesce traffic and exclude boot/management-critical NICs unless recovery is explicitly approved
Validate live tuple and archive durable baseline before each single-direction injection
Complete recovery and evidence closure after TX before separately authorizing RX; abort on boot loop, wrong source or link loss
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/DPC/SyncFlood state
expected_evidence: Vendor direction mapping and approved severity/reset matrix with decoded policy
Separate TX transcript plus durable AER/BMC/UEFI and reset/boot timeline
Fully recovered link/device/traffic state before RX authorization
Separate RX durable evidence and second complete recovery
test_case.recovery: If platform policy does not require reset for the approved ECRC severity, do not force a reset merely to match prose; retain the contradiction for owner correction. TX evidence must be closed before RX begins.

source_conflict.reason: Criteria call the errors correctable while both procedures require immediate reset. Errortype 2/3 direction and severity are uncited and overlap different semantics in rows 59/60; slot 1~N uses one tuple; durable pre-reset evidence and deadlines are absent; 7EF6030 is undecoded, timeout undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.
